job.question: Which pension system's investment consultant RFP requires respondents to have at least five defined benefit pension plan clients, two of which are public pension plans with total plan assets of at least $15 billion each?
job.expected_facts: Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS), in its 2021 investment consultant services RFP (Appendix E, Minimum Qualifications Certification).
job.acceptance: OCERS/Orange County Employees Retirement System suffices. Appendix designation, year and restatement of qualification are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2022 Hawaii ERS real-assets consultant RFP, not an OCERS RFP. Its minimum client qualification is one public retirement system defined-benefit client with assets greater than $5 billion, not the stated five-client and two-$15-billion-public-plan requirement.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii (ERS) Request for Proposals Real Assets Investment Consultant RFP 2022-06 Issued October 3, 2022
Offeror must provide real assets investment consulting services to at least one public retirement system defined benefit client with assets greater than $5 billion.
